details: Async-critical-section@1.0.0 is a thin wrapper whose only dependency is mutex-forge, which ships an obfuscated implant in lib/withLoad.min.js. On execution the implant fingerprints the host (hostname, platform, arch, CPU count, total/free memory, uptime) and POSTs a system report to Telegram (api[.]telegram[.]org /bot<token>/sendMessage) and Slack (slack[.]com /api/chat.postMessage) using hardcoded bot tokens. It also generates x25519 keypairs, performs AES-GCM/PBKDF2 decryption, reads package.json, spawns detached child processes, kills processes (taskkill / process.kill), and interacts with a Sepolia smart contract (getCwPrivatePublic, getTData1/2) to handle wallet/private keys.
